title: Banana & cinnamon porridge
description: Creamy oats, sweet banana, and a warming pinch of cinnamon. A gentle start to the day.
imageAlt: Illustrated placeholder for Banana & cinnamon porridge; food photograph coming soon.
instructions: Put the oats, milk, and cinnamon in a saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer over a medium heat, stirring regularly.
Reduce the heat and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring until creamy. Add a splash of water if the porridge becomes too thick.
Slice the bananas. Divide the porridge between two bowls and top with the banana.

title: Spinach eggs on toast
description: Soft scrambled eggs and wilted spinach piled onto crisp wholemeal toast.
imageAlt: Illustrated placeholder for Spinach eggs on toast; food photograph coming soon.
instructions: Beat the eggs in a bowl. Toast the bread until crisp.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the spinach and stir for 1–2 minutes until wilted.
Turn the heat to low and add the eggs. Gently fold with a spatula for 3–5 minutes, until set with no liquid egg remaining.
Divide the toast between two plates and spoon the eggs and spinach over the top.

title: Chickpea & feta salad
description: A bright, crunchy lunch with chickpeas, juicy tomatoes, and a lemon dressing.
imageAlt: Illustrated placeholder for Chickpea & feta salad; food photograph coming soon.
instructions: Rinse and drain the cooked chickpeas. Chop the tomatoes and cucumber into bite-sized pieces.
Squeeze the lemon into a large bowl and whisk in the olive oil.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, and cucumber. Toss until coated in the dressing.
Crumble the feta over the salad and divide between two bowls.

title: Tomato & spinach pasta
description: A simple tomato sauce with garlic and tender spinach, ready for a relaxed weeknight dinner.
imageAlt: Illustrated placeholder for Tomato & spinach pasta; food photograph coming soon.
instructions: Finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large pan and soften the onion over a medium heat for 5–7 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer gently for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, cook the pasta in a large saucepan of boiling water according to the packet instructions. Reserve a mug of cooking water before draining.
Stir the spinach into the sauce until wilted. Add the drained pasta and a little reserved cooking water to loosen the sauce. Toss and serve.

title: Coconut chicken curry
description: A mild, comforting coconut curry with spinach, served over fluffy basmati rice.
imageAlt: Illustrated placeholder for Coconut chicken curry; food photograph coming soon.
instructions: Chop the onions and garlic. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, then wash your hands and clean the board and knife.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over a medium heat. Soften the onions for 7 minutes, then stir in the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, stirring. Add the coconut milk and tomatoes and bring to a gentle simmer.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through. Meanwhile, cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Check that the chicken has no pink centre and is steaming hot throughout. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then serve with the rice.
